competitors.name: Modern CSV
competitors.price: free version; Premium licences listed at $39 Personal / $59 Business

claims.feature: Correct CSV parsing: quotes, embedded newlines, stray quotes, BOM, delimiter detection, wrong row lengths reported
tests: ui:csv-to-json:A2: a stray quote inside a field is a literal character, not the start of a quoted block
ui:csv-to-json:quoted commas, escaped quotes, embedded newlines, CRLF
ui:csv-to-json:A2: duplicate headers stay separate columns, single-column blanks are kept, short rows are reported
ui:csv-to-json:semicolon delimiter is auto-detected; tab can be forced
unit:csv:A2: a quote that does not start a field is a literal character (Excel behaviour)

claims.feature: Type inference that never changes a value (leading zeros, + signs, long numbers), with per-column types
tests: ui:csv-to-json:A3: Smart Types never change a value: leading zeros, + signs and long numbers stay text; a column can be forced to text
unit:tabular:records: types per column, never changing a value; nesting; plan

claims.feature: Every sheet of an Excel workbook in
tests: ui:csv-to-json:2.4: an Excel workbook: every sheet listed, one sheet or all converted

claims.feature: .xlsx out with typed cells and no formulas
tests: ui:csv-to-json:2.4: .xlsx out keeps text as text and numbers as numbers, and never writes a formula
ui:csv-to-json:2.4: JSON Lines out, and JSON Lines in for JSON -> CSV
unit:tabular:JSON Lines: blank lines skipped, errors carry their line, numbers stay exact
unit:tabular:detectJSON: an array, an object, JSON Lines, and broken JSON stays JSON (for its error)

claims.feature: Nested JSON from dotted headers, and flattening back
tests: ui:csv-to-json:2.4: dotted headers nest into objects and arrays, and flatten back
unit:tabular:nest: dotted headers become nested objects, numeric parts become arrays
unit:tabular:nest: a key that is both a value and a parent is reported and kept flat
unit:tabular:flatten: nested objects and arrays become dotted keys; nest(flatten(x)) is x
ui:csv-to-json:2.4: choose, rename and reorder columns in both directions
unit:tabular:column plan: rename, drop and reorder survive new data; new columns are appended

claims.feature: Files of 100 MB and more, streamed
tests: ui:csv-to-json:2.4: a 40 MB CSV streams through a Worker with progress and a preview; Save holds every record
ui:csv-to-json:2.4: streaming in a Worker gives exactly the in-memory result, for messy CSV and for JSON Lines
unit:tabular:stream reader: same rows and issues as the in-memory parser at every split size
unit:tabular:stream reader: a random 5,000-row file with quotes and newlines, random slices
ui:csv-to-json:2.4: the table preview is editable and edits go back into the input
ui:csv-to-json:A4: JSON to CSV is safe for spreadsheets by default and keeps long numbers
unit:tabular:csvRow: the escape rule of the CSV writer, formulas guarded when asked
